effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] When this Digimon attacks a player, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has the [Machine] or [Dragonkin] trait, it gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.).
